title: AI supervision
unavailable.title: Supervision controls are not available here
stateText.active: AI supervision is running for this learner.
stateText.paused: Paused: no new AI calls or changes. Work already started finishes its current call, then waits.
stateText.stopped: Stopped: every unfinished AI job was cancelled and nothing more is published until you resume.
result.unchanged: Nothing changed: that was already in force.
result.stopped: Supervision stopped. {count, plural, one {# unfinished job is} other {# unfinished jobs are}} being cancelled.
pendingSignals: {count, plural, one {# wake-up signal is} other {# wake-up signals are}} still on their way to running jobs. The stored state already applies.
confirmStop.title: Stop cancels unfinished work
confirmStop.body: Every unfinished AI job for this learner is cancelled and will not resume; new events start fresh only after you resume.
readOnly: Your role can see supervision but not change it.
jobs.title: Unfinished jobs
jobs.empty: No unfinished AI jobs for this learner.
undelivered.title: Requests that did not run
undelivered.empty: Every request for this learner reached AI supervision.
undelivered.explain: Refused: the request's state changed for good (for example consent was withdrawn) and it will not be retried. Quarantined: delivery kept failing after its retries.
undelivered.explainRequeue: Refused: the request's state changed for good (for example consent was withdrawn) and it will not be retried. Quarantined: delivery kept failing after its retries. Once the outage is over you may re-queue a quarantined request once, with a reason.
requeue.title: Re-queue {request}
requeue.body: The request is delivered again with fresh attempts, which may start paid AI work. This is recorded with your name and reason, and a request can be re-queued only once.
requeue.done: Request re-queued with fresh attempts. It is delivered again shortly; it cannot be re-queued a second time.
eventType.companion_retry_requested: Companion question asked again automatically (no reply came)
deliveryReason.attempts_exhausted: delivery kept failing after its retries
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_PREPARATION_CO: the request's state changed before it could run
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_COMPANION_CONT: the companion request no longer matched the learner's lesson
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_INPUT_STALE: the learner's record changed before it could run
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_INPUT_NOT_FOUN: what it referred to no longer exists
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_UNCONFIGURED: AI supervision is not set up
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_INVALID_CONFIG: the AI supervision settings are not valid
deliveryReason.SUPERVISOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH: it referred to another learner or course
